prompt: Eoghan started helping at a pet shelter in Tegucigalpa after school, and he never left. He still feeds twenty rescue cats before breakfast. If he (not / to choose) that shelter back then, he (not / to spend) his mornings with those cats today. Also, if he (not / to be) such a patient person, he (to give) up during the noisy first week.
explanation_ru: Первое условие связывает решение в прошлом (Past Perfect) с результатом в настоящем (would + V1). Второе связывает постоянную черту характера сейчас (Past Simple) с результатом в прошлом (would have + V3).

prompt: — Did you join the sunrise walk from the hostel in Lublin? — No, I slept straight through my alarm. I am a terrible morning person: if I (to sleep) more lightly, I (to hear) the phone at five. Still, if I (to catch) that early bus, I (to feel) exhausted in this cafe instead of enjoying my coffee.
explanation_ru: Сначала постоянная особенность в настоящем (Past Simple) влияет на утреннее событие в прошлом (would/could have + V3), затем прошлое условие (Past Perfect) даёт результат в настоящем (would + V1).

prompt: Ten years ago, Carmen's brother dared her to try a judo class in Seville, and she still trains three evenings a week. If she (to refuse) his challenge back then, she (not / to hold) a black belt today. Even her coach admits that if Carmen (not / to have) such strong discipline, she (to leave) the club after her first tough tournament.
explanation_ru: Решение десятилетней давности (Past Perfect) объясняет сегодняшний результат (would + V1), а постоянное качество Кармен (Past Simple) относится к прошлому турниру (would have + V3).

prompt: I am writing from Stockholm with frustrating news about my online exam. I forgot my password five minutes before the test started and got locked out of the portal. If I (to write) the login details in my notebook beforehand, I (not / to need) a retake date today. Honestly, if I (not / to trust) my own memory so much, I (to check) the account the evening before.
explanation_ru: Прошлое действие (Past Perfect) приводит к необходимости пересдачи сейчас (would not need), а постоянная привычка доверять памяти (Past Simple) — к пропущенной проверке в прошлом (would have + V3).

prompt: Back in March, a major investor walked away from Aditi's start-up in Bangalore at the final stage. Looking at the company accounts today, she realises how different things might look. If the investor (to sign) that contract in spring, the team (to work) in a much larger office today. At the same time, if Aditi (not / to care) so much about full control, she (to accept) a cheaper offer from another firm.
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие в марте (Past Perfect) даёт результат в настоящем (would be working / would work), а постоянный принцип Адити (Past Simple) объясняет её отказ в прошлом (would have + V3).

prompt: Oscar runs a cosy family hotel in Katowice, though his career nearly went another way. Years ago, a bank in Warsaw offered him a senior post, and he turned it down. If he (to take) that city job, he (to wear) a suit in an office instead of greeting guests at reception. Still, if he (not / to love) hospitality so deeply, he (not / to stay) in his hometown when his parents retired.
explanation_ru: Выбор в прошлом (Past Perfect) определяет его нынешнюю работу (would + V1 / be + V-ing), а нынешняя любовь к делу (Past Simple) объясняет решение в прошлом (would not have + V3).

prompt: My grandfather taught me how to bake crusty loaves in Phnom Penh, and I still pass that recipe on at my cooking school. If I (to switch) to quick factory methods when the shop grew busy, my students (not / to learn) the traditional dough technique in class today. People often ask why I refused a big supermarket contract, too. If I (to want) easy money above all else, I (to sell) the family recipe in my twenties.
explanation_ru: В первом случае прошлое решение (Past Perfect) влияет на сегодняшние занятия (would not learn / be learning), во втором постоянное отношение к деньгам (Past Simple) — на поступок в молодости (would have + V3).

prompt: Min-seo is still in the chemistry lab in Seoul, staring at a ruined sample. Her main test failed right before the deadline, so she cannot hand in her paper today. If the cooling pump (not / to break) overnight, her final report (to be) on her professor's desk today. Even worse, if Min-seo (to know) how to fix the pump herself, she (to save) the experiment before midnight.
explanation_ru: Поломка насоса ночью (Past Perfect) привела к проблеме сегодня (would be), а отсутствие навыка ремонта вообще (Past Simple) помешало спасти опыт до полуночи (would/could have + V3).

prompt: Dear Haruto, I still feel awful about losing that big client in Fukuoka. I attached the draft price list instead of the final version, and the client cancelled immediately. If I (to open) the file once more before hitting send, we (to manage) their account this quarter. Honestly, if I (not / to rush) through emails as a habit, that silly error (not / to happen) at all.
explanation_ru: Непроверенный файл в прошлом (Past Perfect) лишил команду контракта в этом квартале (would manage / be managing), а постоянная привычка спешить (Past Simple) привела к ошибке в прошлом (would not have + V3).

prompt: All of Siobhan's tomato plants are black; if she (to cover) them last night, they (to look) healthy today.
explanation_ru: Действие прошлой ночи требует Past Perfect (had covered), а состояние растений сегодня — would + инфинитив без to.

prompt: — Why is this stew salty? — If I (not / to add) extra salt, we (to eat) it happily now.
explanation_ru: Лишнюю соль добавили в прошлом (Past Perfect), а результат мешает ужинать прямо сейчас (would be eating / would eat).

prompt: Everyone says I am too impatient: if I (to have) a bit more patience, I (not / to leave) the art fair in Stara Zagora before the prize announcement.
explanation_ru: Нетерпеливость — постоянная черта в настоящем (Past Simple — had), а преждевременный уход с выставки произошёл в прошлом (would not have left).

prompt: Arthur really struggles with early mornings. (Arthur / to miss) the geology bus in Dnipro where his class found that rare fossil if he (to wake) up easily?
explanation_ru: Трудности с ранним подъёмом относятся к настоящему (Past Simple — woke), а пропущенный автобус — к прошлому (Would Arthur have missed).

prompt: Orla still unlocks her tiny bookshop in Dublin each morning because she refused an online retailer; if she (to sell) the shop back then, where (she / to work) today?
explanation_ru: Продажа магазина могла произойти в прошлом (Past Perfect — had sold), а вопрос касается её нынешнего места работы (would she work / be working).

prompt: Look at this borrowed jumper I am wearing in Västerås: if I (not / to forget) my suitcase on the platform, I (to wear) my own warm coat today.
explanation_ru: Чемодан забыли на платформе в прошлом (had not forgotten), а результат проявляется сегодня (would be wearing / would wear).

prompt: The clerk in Krasnoyarsk chose office work over the police; if she ___ the other path, she would not sit here today.
options: chose
had chosen
would choose
would have chosen
explanation_ru: Решение принято в прошлом, поэтому после if нужен Past Perfect (had chosen). Типичная ошибка — ставить would / would have после if или путать с Past Simple.

prompt: Connor left his passport at the hotel in Rome; if he had checked his bag, he ___ on the train now.
options: would have been
will be
were
would be
explanation_ru: Результат относится к настоящему моменту (now), поэтому нужен would be. Типичная ошибка — механически ставить would have been после if + Past Perfect.

prompt: Sepp is naturally careless with borrowed books; if he were better organised, he ___ the wrong novel to the school library in Kaduna or lost his place in the prize.
options: would not have returned
would not return
will not return
had not returned
explanation_ru: Условие описывает постоянную черту (were), а возврат не той книги случился в прошлом, поэтому нужен would not have returned. Частая ошибка — выбирать would not return по шаблону второго типа.

prompt: Vikram stayed up revising in Delhi until sunrise and slept through his morning paper; if he had gone to bed at midnight, he ___ wide awake and relieved right now.
options: will be
would have been
would be
was
explanation_ru: Речь о самочувствии прямо сейчас (right now) как следствии прошлого решения, поэтому верно would be. Ошибка — ставить would have been для результата в настоящем.

prompt: Honestly, my partner in Tramore laughs at how soft I am: if I ___ stricter on duty, I would have handed out a big fine to that parked van blocking the lane.
options: would be
were
will be
am
explanation_ru: Мягкий характер — постоянный факт в настоящем, поэтому в нереальном условии нужен Past Simple (were). Типичная ошибка — ставить would be или will be после if.

prompt: Ryota switched his olive grove in Chania to organic farming years ago, so his bees still produce chemical-free honey today.
options: If Ryota had not switched to organic farming, his honey would not be chemical-free today.
If Ryota did not switch to organic farming, his honey would not have been chemical-free today.
If Ryota had not switched to organic farming, his honey would not have been chemical-free today.
If Ryota has not switched to organic farming, his honey will not be chemical-free today.
explanation_ru: Прошлое решение требует Past Perfect (had not switched), а нынешнее качество мёда — would not be, а не would not have been.

prompt: The manager of the small cinema in Baotou chose film work over a teaching career, and she still loves running evening screenings.
options: If she chose teaching instead of cinema work, she would have stood in a classroom on weekday evenings.
If she would have chosen teaching instead of cinema work, she would be marking homework instead of running screenings.
If she had chosen teaching instead of cinema work, she would be marking homework instead of running screenings.
If she had chosen teaching instead of cinema work, she would have marked homework instead of running screenings today.
explanation_ru: Выбор профессии в прошлом выражается через Past Perfect (had chosen), а нынешняя повседневная деятельность — через would be marking.

prompt: My friends always tease me for losing things, and at the music festival in Changsha I dropped my ticket at the gate and watched the first band from outside.
options: If I had been more organised in general, I would stand near the stage for the first band.
If I were more organised, I would not have watched the first band from outside the gate.
If I would be more organised, I would not have watched the first band from outside the gate.
If I were more organised, I would not watch the first band from outside the gate.
explanation_ru: Общая черта характера в настоящем передаётся формой Past Simple (were), а событие на прошедшем фестивале — конструкцией would not have watched.

prompt: A blocked drain outside Dewi's shop in Jakarta let rainwater flood in overnight, and now her dry stock is completely ruined.
options: If the city had cleared that drain earlier, Dewi's stock would have been dry right now.
If the city cleared that drain earlier, Dewi's stock would be dry right now.
If the city would have cleared that drain earlier, Dewi's stock would be dry right now.
If the city had cleared that drain earlier, Dewi's stock would be dry right now.
explanation_ru: Прочистить сток нужно было в прошлом (had cleared), а состояние товара относится к настоящему (would be dry right now).

prompt: If Nicole had not picked the early shift in Dar es Salaam, she would not open her corner shop at six.
options: Nicole picked the early shift, and she still opens her shop at six.
Nicole did not pick the early shift, so she does not open her shop at six.
Nicole picked the early shift, but she stopped opening her shop at six.
Nicole is picking the early shift today, so she opened her shop at six.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное нереальное условие в прошлом (had not picked) означает, что она выбрала раннюю смену; отрицательный результат в настоящем (would not open) означает, что она и сейчас открывает магазин в шесть.

prompt: Lisa's goldfish would still be eating properly if she had taken it to the vet in Gdynia sooner.
options: Lisa took her goldfish to the vet sooner, and it is eating properly.
Lisa did not take her goldfish to the vet sooner, and it is not eating properly.
Lisa does not take her goldfish to the vet, so it did not eat properly earlier.
Lisa did not take her goldfish to the vet sooner, but it is still eating properly.
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие в прошлом (had taken) означает, что Лиза не отвезла рыбку к ветеринару, а нереальный результат в настоящем (would still be eating) — что сейчас рыбка не ест.

prompt: Gunnar would not spend his weekdays cleaning ancient clay pots at the Sarajevo museum if he had chosen law at university.
options: Gunnar chose law at university and never worked at the Sarajevo museum.
Gunnar did not choose law at university, so he cleaned pots at the museum once.
Gunnar did not choose law at university, and he spends his weekdays cleaning pots at the museum.
Gunnar wants to study law today, so he stopped working at the Sarajevo museum.
explanation_ru: Обе части меняют полярность при сохранении своего времени: в прошлом Гуннар не выбрал право (had chosen -> did not choose), а в настоящем он работает с экспонатами в музее (would not spend -> spends).

prompt: If Viggo had picked football over swimming as a teenager in Gdynia, he would not be training in the pool at dawn.
options: Viggo picked football as a teenager, so he avoids the swimming pool at dawn.
Viggo did not pick football as a teenager, and he did not train in the pool at dawn.
Viggo plays football today because he gave up swimming as a teenager.
Viggo did not pick football as a teenager, so he still trains in the pool at dawn.
explanation_ru: Прошлое нереальное условие (had picked) говорит, что Вигго не выбрал футбол, а настоящее (would not be training) — что он и сегодня тренируется в бассейне на рассвете.

prompt: The ferry captain in Piraeus would not have delayed the crossing after the wind warning if he were not so cautious by nature.
options: The captain is cautious by nature, so he delayed the crossing after the wind warning.
The captain is not cautious by nature, so he cancelled the crossing after the wind warning.
The captain was cautious that morning, so he is delaying the crossing today.
The captain is cautious by nature, so he refused to delay the crossing.
explanation_ru: Постоянное условие (were not cautious) в реальности означает, что капитан осторожен сейчас, а прошлый результат (would not have delayed) — что он действительно задержал рейс.

prompt: If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she would not have run her small photo studio in Pleven today.
answer: If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she would not be running her small photo studio in Pleven today.
accepted_answers: If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she would not be running her small photo studio in Pleven today.
If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she wouldn't be running her small photo studio in Pleven today.
If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she would not run her small photo studio in Pleven today.
If Katerina had taken the magazine job, she wouldn't run her small photo studio in Pleven today.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить would not have + V3 для результата, который относится к настоящему (today); здесь нужен would not run или would not be running.

prompt: Made's lab in Kaunas has faulty wiring: if the building would have modern cables, the lamp would not have flickered during the test.
answer: Made's lab in Kaunas has faulty wiring: if the building had modern cables, the lamp would not have flickered during the test.
accepted_answers: Made's lab in Kaunas has faulty wiring: if the building had modern cables, the lamp would not have flickered during the test.
Made's lab in Kaunas has faulty wiring: if the building had modern cables, the lamp wouldn't have flickered during the test.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — использовать would после if (по аналогии с русским «если бы»). Для нереального состояния в настоящем нужен Past Simple (had).

prompt: Our neighbour's cat is sleeping safely on the balcony in Leiden, because if a kind stranger had not read its collar, we would still be searching the streets.
answer: Our neighbour's cat is sleeping safely on the balcony in Leiden, because if a kind stranger had not read its collar, we would still be searching the streets.
accepted_answers: Our neighbour's cat is sleeping safely on the balcony in Leiden, because if a kind stranger had not read its collar, we would still be searching the streets.
Our neighbour's cat is sleeping safely on the balcony in Leiden, because if a kind stranger hadn't read its collar, we would still be searching the streets.
explanation_ru: Предложение полностью верно: прошлое условие (had not read) правильно сочетается с длительным результатом в настоящем (would still be searching).

prompt: Sora's afternoon commute in Santiago.
sentences: I jumped onto the wrong metro train during the rush in Santiago and ended up across town.
I am sitting in a crowded waiting room because I missed my dentist appointment.
If I had checked the platform sign properly, I would have been back at my flat right now.
Honestly, if I were less distracted after work, I would not have boarded the wrong train in the first place.
From today on, I am keeping my phone in my pocket on the platform.

fixes.2: If I had checked the platform sign properly, I would be back at my flat right now.

explanation_ru: В третьем предложении результат относится к настоящему моменту (right now), поэтому вместо would have been нужно would be.

prompt: Kenji's train mistake near Kyoto.
sentences: Kenji normally catches the express train from Kyoto, so his colleagues rarely see him arrive late.
This morning he stepped onto the slow local train by mistake and missed the start of his meeting.
If he would have taken the express as usual, he would not be apologising to the client now.
Still, if he were not so tired these days, he would not mix up the two platforms this morning.
He has promised himself an early night once he gets home.

fixes.2: If he had taken the express as usual, he would not be apologising to the client now.
fixes.3: Still, if he were not so tired these days, he would not have mixed up the two platforms this morning.

explanation_ru: В третьем предложении нельзя ставить would have после if (нужно had taken); в четвёртом результат относится к утру (прошлому), поэтому нужно would not have mixed up.

prompt: The shop owner in Charleville left the back door unlocked, so he has to pay for a new lock today. → If the shop owner in Charleville …
answer: If the shop owner in Charleville had not left the back door unlocked, he would not have to pay for a new lock today.
accepted_answers: If the shop owner in Charleville had not left the back door unlocked, he would not have to pay for a new lock today.
If the shop owner in Charleville hadn't left the back door unlocked, he wouldn't have to pay for a new lock today.
If the shop owner in Charleville had not left the back door unlocked, he wouldn't have to pay for a new lock today.
If the shop owner in Charleville hadn't left the back door unlocked, he would not have to pay for a new lock today.
explanation_ru: Незапертая дверь — действие в прошлом (Past Perfect: had not left), а необходимость платить за новый замок — результат сегодня (would not have to pay).
